text: Emergency medicine is a branch of clinical medicine that studies the diagnosis, rescue and management of acute and critical conditions, trauma and public health emergencies, with the core of "saving lives, stabilizing conditions and preventing complications". The course aims to cultivate students' emergency assessment thinking, first aid operation skills and multidisciplinary collaboration abilities, and equip them with the clinical competence to quickly identify fatal diseases (such as myocardial infarction and stroke) and handle emergency situations (such as cardiac arrest and severe trauma).
